Priya (PM): Quick sync: Prospect 'Helix' wants private pilot + HSM + p95 SLA. Staging window = EoQ. Need cross-team plan.
Evan (Runtime): HSM + p95 in private is doable but we need infra slot + runtime tuning (KV caching + quant checks).
Marco (Infra): Only 1 spare prewarm slot left; currently promised to Beacon. We can reassign but Beacon will need a compensated burst or 2wk slip.
Priya (PM): Helix will accept a staggered ramp if it helps: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with gating.
Tara (Security): HSM requires attestation + short pen test. Estimate: attestation/config ~8 business days, pen test ~3 days post-infra. Key policy sign-off required pre-prod.
Evan (Runtime): I'll own the rollout playbook and fallback. Need tracing + token-level telemetry for canary and a small prompt-set for regressions. Planned canary snippet:
```yaml
canary:
  - pct: 10
    dur: 48h
  - pct: 40
    dur: 72h
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - p95_latency_delta_pct: 12
```
Marco (Infra): If Priya confirms slot transfer by EOD Tue, infra (VPC peering, NATs, routes) ready in ~7 days. I'll prepare a template now.
Priya (PM): Action items: (1) Priya -> negotiate Beacon slot transfer by EOD Tue; (2) Marco -> infra template after confirmation; (3) Evan -> playbook + telemetry hooks by next Wed; (4) Tara -> schedule attestation & pen test. ops-bot please create launch-lane ticket.
ops-bot: Reminder: created ticket "Helix private pilot" at /boards/launch-lane/Helix-private-pilot.
Priya (PM): Thanks — I'll post Beacon thread link once I have it. :thumbsup:
